title: ARKETEAM Protectel modules PROTECTELMAJ and BDF allow low privileged users to use some of the functionalities reserved…
description: A vulnerability in ARKETEAM Protectel modules PROTECTELMAJ and BDF allows low privileged users to access some functionalities reserved for admin users by forging direct requests to a specific endpoint. This issue has been fixed in PROTECTELMAJ version 6.5.19 and BDF version 6.4.67.
